items.price: $160-220k (LabX 2026 guide); a 7800 system was $122,526 net in 2017 (Agilent quote)

HEMCO UniFlow Trace Metals, 6 ft, polypropylene, on an acid cabinet
items.source: HEMCO UniFlow Trace Metals hood (LabWrench listing; HEMCO's literature): one-piece welded polypropylene chamber and baffle, 6 ft = 72 x 32 x 59 in, four horizontal sliding sashes on two tracks (at most half open), 100 fpm face velocity. Base cabinet and work surface heights estimated

items.product: acid-rated, all-fluoropolymer fluid path (Questron/HORIBA QPrep class), with a decapping head (ours)
items.source: Questron (HORIBA) QPrep: 'all-plastic construction', 'Teflon-coated rigid graphite probe', dilutes, spikes internal standard, fills racks, 6 autosampler racks; size not published (ours, estimated). Hamilton Microlab STAR line operator's manual: the CO-RE head is rated 3, not for continuous contact, with 5-10 % and 70 % nitric acid; STARlet 1124 x 795 x 903 mm, 135 kg. Gilson GX-271 manual: avoid nitric acid over 10 % on PEEK. Opentrons OT-2 and Flex manuals: 'Keep corrosive materials ... away from the robot'

items.product: graphite digestion block (SCP Science DigiPREP class), 24 x 50 mL
items.source: SCP Science DigiPREP: graphite hot block, up to 450 C, 50 mL tubes; size estimated

items.product: 180 L liquid argon dewar, 22 psi, regulator within 3 m
items.source: Airgas 180 L liquid argon, 22 psi: about 143 m3 of gas, 508 mm diameter, 1635 mm tall; at 20 L/min about 119 h of plasma, three weeks of 8 h days less boil-off (PerkinElmer: expect a new dewar every 2-3 weeks)

items.product: PTFE-laminate robot suit for the UR12e (Roboworld Robosuit class)
items.source: Roboworld Robosuit for UR3-UR12e (UR+ listing): over 18 fabrics, a 10-mil laminated Teflon option for 'caustic chemical environments', zips or hook-and-loop, quote only; no maker publishes an IP rating. UR: the UR12e (the renamed UR10e) is IP54, and where liquids are present 'additional measures should be taken, such as utilizing a protective robot cover'

items.product: 15 mL PP tube racks with a central handle (ours); PP screw caps
